report.math_notes: Target: U(Q_5) exactly plus an optimal labelling in the required format. Both directions established. LOWER BOUND: T = 80 + v + X (Lemma 3) with X = sum over oriented edges of (p(tail)-1) >= 0 is verified. Lemma 4 (light vertices have in-degree <= 1, light sets induce forests) and Lemma 5 (each heavy vertex contributes c >= 3, with c = 3 only for (deg-, p) in {(2,2),(4,4)}) are correct. Lemma 7's in-degree count 4q = 48 + v + |H| - s_H is correct since every vertex outside peaks and heavy vertices has p = 1 and in-degree 0 or 1. The case split |H| in {0,1,2} for T <= 87 is exhaustive; |H|=2 is killed by divisibility, |H|=0 gives 13 independent peaks with forest complement, |H|=1 gives 12 independent peaks, u not a peak, forest on the other 19 vertices. Reduction to (*) is valid. (*) is a finite statement on Q_5; the XOR-translation reduction is sound; I read code_2 and code_3: code_2 enumerates each independent 12-set containing 0 exactly once (only pruning is the trivially necessary remaining-vertex count) and tests forests by |E| = |V| - #components; code_3 enumerates all 3672 independent 12-sets via (even part, odd part) with no symmetry reduction and tests by union-find. The count 3672 matches an independent hand count (C(16,12)*2 pure + 32 mixed sets), and 3672*12/32 = 1377 matches. Orchestrator re-runs report 0 acyclic complements in both, covering all 73440 pairs (I,u). Hence no labelling has T <= 87. UPPER BOUND: the listed 32 strings are distinct; peaks = the 14 even vertices other than 00000 and 11110; the two stars have disjoint neighbourhoods (distance 4); the 6 remaining odd vertices are isolated in F. Hand count 18 + 14*5 = 88 checks, and two independent scripts (recursion, explicit DFS) return 88 under orchestrator re-run. Conclusion U(Q_5) = 88 with the explicit labelling is established. The proof is self-contained (verified_1/verified_4 are not actually needed). Dependency to expose: the lower bound rests on the exhaustive finite check of (*), whose reduction to a finite set is proved in Section 2 and whose execution is confirmed by trusted orchestrator observations; no pruning rules beyond the proved symmetry reduction are used.
